provenance.quote: An autonomous coverage robot comprising
a chassis having forward and rearward portions
a drive system carried by the chassis and configured to maneuver the robot over a cleaning surface
a cleaning assembly mounted on the forward portion of the chassis
a bin disposed adjacent the cleaning assembly and configured to receive debris agitated by the cleaning assembly
a bin cover pivotally attached to a portion of the chassis and configured to rotate between a first, closed position and a second, open position
a body attached to the chassis
a handle disposed on an upper portion of the body
a bin cover release configured to control movement of the bin cover between its first and second positions
a first roller brush rotatably mounted substantially near a front edge of the chassis
a second roller brush rotatably mounted parallel to and rearward of the first roller brush, the first and second roller brushes rotate in opposite directions
each roller brush comprises right and left end brushes extending from respective ends of the roller brush beyond a lateral extend of the body
each roller brush comprises right and left end brushes extending from respective ends of the roller brush beyond a lateral extend of the body
the bin cover release comprises a spring biased latch
a button disposed on the handle and configured to actuate the latch
one proximity sensor carried by a side of the robot, the proximity sensor responsive to an obstacle substantially near the body
at least one cliff sensor carried by a forward portion of the body and arranged substantially near a front edge of the body
at least one cliff sensor carried by a rearward portion of the body and arranged substantially near the rear edge of the body
a stasis detector comprising a magnet disposed in or on the idler wheel
a magnet disposed in or on the idler wheel
a magnet detector disposed adjacent the idler wheel for detecting the magnet as the idler wheel rotates
a bumper guide configured to confine body movements to along two directions
two orthogonal grooves defined by the body and configured to receive a guide pin disposed on the chassis
guide pin disposed on the chassis
the controller configured to alter a drive direction in response to a signal received from the proximity sensor
right and left differentially driven drive wheels rotatably mounted to the rearward portion of the chassis
an idler wheel disposed on the bin cover
right and left side roller brushes rotatably mounted orthogonal to the front brush substantially near the respective right and left side edges of the chassis
right and left side roller brushes rotatably mounted orthogonal to the front brush substantially near the respective right and left side edges of the chassis
